title: Chicago versus New York; Mattie Hite urges her to go east
summary: Chicago was always the greatest, but Mattie Hite told her she belonged in New York, so she decided to go to higher ground.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now, how did New York -- you came to
How did that compare to Chicago?
Nothing. Chicago was always the greatest.

Always the greatest. It still is, I guess. Chicago was the greatest, yeah. And I tell you, you asked me how I happened to think about coming to New York, Mattie Height, a girl that was with Cora Green and them down there at the Panama, she said to me, said, 'Girl, you ain't got no business here; (unintelligible) you've got to go to brighter fields. You go to New York, you belong in New York, go on to New York.' And then I kind of made up my mind then, I believe I will go, you know. I made up my mind then. I said, well, I'm going on to higher ground.
